annotations.title: Get the next step for a quote

description:
Get the next step for the quote the user chose. Pass the quote_handle from zebra_start_session and the chosen
quote's quote_id from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

Follow recommended_next if present; otherwise give the user the url to continue buying the policy on The Zebra.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the quote the user picked, from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

name: zebra_get_rate_action

instruction.description: How and when to call it.

recommended_next.description: The tool to call next to continue buying in this chat. When absent, give the user the url.

url.description: Where the user continues buying the policy on The Zebra.
